description: Defines when to trigger upsell conversations, what to offer, and how to track upsell pipeline for active clients.

triggerRules.ruleName: Excellent Health Score — 2 Months in a Row
triggerRules.description: Client has scored Excellent (80+) on their health score for 2 consecutive months. This is the primary upsell trigger.
triggerRules.note: Only trigger when results are clearly showing. This is the strongest position to upsell from — the client already trusts the work.

upsellServices.description: Instagram and Facebook content creation, posting, and account management. Builds brand presence and drives engagement alongside SEO.
upsellServices.pitchAngle: Your SEO is working — people are finding you on Google. Social media is the next layer. It builds trust before they even search — someone sees your Instagram, remembers the brand, then searches for you specifically. It compounds the SEO work.
bestFitFor: Visual niches like Dental, Skin, Gyms, Interior Designers
upsellServices.pricingNote: Custom — discuss with client based on content volume needed

upsellServices.description: Paid search campaigns on Google to capture high-intent leads immediately. Runs alongside organic SEO for maximum SERP coverage.
upsellServices.pitchAngle: Your organic rankings are strong. Google Ads on top means you own two spots on the same search results page — the paid ad at the top and your organic result below. Competitors only have one. It also captures leads instantly while SEO continues to compound.
bestFitFor: IVF, Dental, Car Rentals, JEE/NEET Coaching
upsellServices.pricingNote: Service fee + client's ad budget (ad budget paid directly to Google by client)

step1.description: When trigger conditions are met, FMOS marks the client as 'Upsell Ready' and surfaces them on the admin dashboard with a notification.

step2.stepName: Jabeer Reviews and Decides Which Service to Offer
step2.description: Jabeer looks at the client's profile — niche, city, current results, and health score trend — and decides whether to pitch Social Media, Google Ads, or both.

decisionGuide.reason: Visual, B2C — Instagram content builds strong brand trust

decisionGuide.niche: IVF, Car Rentals, JEE/NEET, Computer Training
decisionGuide.reason: High intent, decision-driven — paid ads capture leads faster
Long sales cycle — social builds awareness, ads capture active buyers

step3.description: Jabeer calls the client directly — same personal approach as the first meeting. References their results and introduces the upsell naturally.

step4.description: If the client needs more context, book a short Zoom call. Walk through the upsell proposal — show what social media or Google Ads would add on top of current results.

step5.description: Log the result of the upsell conversation in FMOS.
